name: mindustry-packloader
author: Anzuno
description:
Bulk import maps (.msav) and schematics (.msch) directly from ZIP archives or folders on Android and Desktop.

Features:
- Bulk Import: Import dozens of maps and schematics from .zip packs or folders in one operation.
- Smart Conflict Handling: Choose how to resolve duplicate files (Skip, Overwrite, Rename).
- Instant Hot-Reload: Automatically reloads game maps and schematics immediately without restarting Mindustry.
- Safe & Validated: Built-in Zip Slip protection, format header validation, and atomic writes.
- Mobile-Optimized: Touch-friendly UI, search filtering, and System File Picker (SAF) support.
- Seamless Integration: Quick-access buttons in Main Menu, Schematics, Custom Game, and Map Editor.

Usage:
- Main Menu: Click "Pack Loader" to open the loader dialog.
- Schematics / Maps Menus: Click "Import .zip" or "Scan Folder" directly inside the respective dialogs.
- Import Workflow: Choose Source -> Review & Select -> Select Conflict Policy -> Import Selected.
